data.long_meaning: The name Viresh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vish', which means 'poison'. This name is given to a boy born on a day when the planets are in such alignment that the child is believed to have the power to control poison. This name signifies strength, courage, and the ability to protect oneself and others from harm.
